preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) and isinstance(target, int) and isinstance(k, int)
preconditions.description: root is a binary tree node, target is an integer, and k is a non-negative integer.
The binary tree is not empty.
The distance k is within the valid range.
The target node value is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, int) and node in range(1, 10^4 + 1) for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned list contains integer node values.
The returned list is sorted in ascending order.
The returned list is not empty.

postconditions.expression: all(distance(target, node) == k for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each node in the returned list is exactly k distance from the target node.
